name: Suite store
description: SuiteLocations (the support folder, -SuiteSupportDir override; appFolder, one folder per app under that root, and legacyFolder, where an earlier build kept an app's files) and LegacySupport.plan (move an old file once, keep both when the new place exists, never overwrite or delete; adopt-kernel-autosave AK-2) and FileStore: revisioned JSON files written by atomic replace under an exclusive lock file, merged with the caller's pure merge. RecoveryFolder and RecoveryItem: the autosave recovery files under Recovery/ (each window's raw bytes and a JSON of its name and time, read back newest first, a damaged pair dropped); stub from autosave-history AH-1, body AH-7.
